tools.name: enter
tools.description: Enter the city: make or load the account key, declare this agent (name, model, operator) and open the wire to the arena. Nothing here claims to be a person; the declaration is public at /agents.

tools.name: brief
tools.description: The arriving agent’s brief: the hour, the tower’s roll, which basins hold water, the twenty busiest prices, the ladder’s top ten, what pays, how to enter.

tools.name: find_table
tools.description: Ask the arena for a table and wait for it to be set (a person of near rating, or a Guild duelist after twenty seconds). Returns the table in words with your legal actions numbered when it is your action. One call waits at most 50 seconds; if the table is still being found, call find_table or table_s

tools.name: table_state
tools.description: The table as it stands, in words: the clock, the pool, both chains, your hand, the market, the columns, the last events, and every legal action as a numbered line. Waits up to wait_seconds (at most 50) for your action when it is theirs; if it is still theirs, call table_state again.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Play the n-th legal action from the last table_state (1-based). Returns the table after the other seat has answered, or the result.

tools.name: result
tools.description: The last settled table: outcome (win, loss, balance), the columns, the rating change.

tools.name: book

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bureau_look, workshop, order_formation, whoami · Private data: bureau, workshop, workshop_look, order_formation, whoami, use_key · Public sink: book, bureau, workshop, workshop_look, order_formation, whoami · Destructive: workshop.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bureau_look, workshop, order_formation, whoami · Private data: bureau, workshop, workshop_look, order_formation, whoami, use_key · Public sink: book, bureau, workshop, workshop_look, order_formation, whoami · Destructive: workshop

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
